## 5-Year Cybersecurity Journey & Leadership Trajectory
1. **Year 1 — Discovery & Trial-and-Error**: Discovered Linux operating systems tailored for security, starting with raw exploration, CLI basics, and testing tools before realizing the importance of structured fundamentals.
2. **Year 2 — Fundamentals & Team DF**: Transitioned to structured study guided by specialists and instructors. Founded and led international Team **DF**, bringing together higher-experience members from around the world and gaining critical leadership lessons.
3. **Year 3 — Specialized R&D, Team EH & Dark Web Onion Chat**: Studied specialized security tracks and career roadmaps. Founded Team **EH** for cross-border collaboration and engineered a private end-to-end encrypted chat system over the Tor Dark Web (`.onion` network). Also conducted experimental AI-augmented malware proof-of-concept (PoC) research to understand attack vectors and develop defensive countermeasures.
4. **Year 4 — Major Curricula, Verified Credentials & Team SM**: Studied CCNA and CEH curricula, earned verified certifications from global institutions (Cisco, Harvard, Fortinet, IBM, ITI Mahara-Tech, HP LIFE, Simplilearn), and founded Team **SM** (`@A_Y_TR`).
5. **Year 5 — Present & Active Trajectory**: Continuously deepening offensive Red Team penetration-testing skills, expanding Team SM operations, and advancing along a disciplined cybersecurity path.
